page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5.xlarge is an x86_64 storage- and memory-focused instance belonging to the Local SSDs instance family. Built on KVM virtualization, it provides 4 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor clocked at 3.4 GHz. System memory is provisioned at 32.0 GB, yielding a high ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Storage architecture features a bundled local SSD volume offering 959 GB of integrated capacity, eliminating dependence on external network block volumes for primary I/O paths. Network throughput is backed by a 10 Gbps baseline interface, and the instance operates without hardware graphics accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Resource allocation delivers cost efficiency by pairing dedicated compute threads and generous memory density with bundled high-speed local disk space. Because local SSD storage is non-volatile only within the lifecycle of the host hardware, workloads requiring durability must implement data replication or snapshot mechanisms. This configuration is directly suited for transactional databases, distributed NoSQL engines, search indexes, in-memory caches requiring persistent storage persistence, and analytical data processing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5.xlarge is a dedicated local-storage instance built on x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization. Powered by a 3.4 GHz Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor, the instance provides 4 dedicated vCPUs coupled with 32.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a generous 8.0 GB RAM per vCPU allocation. The hardware profile includes 959 GB of integrated local SSD storage, alongside a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile. Operating without discrete GPU hardware, it optimizes resource efficiency by bundling substantial high-speed local disk capacity directly with a memory-heavy compute environment. The instance is structured for I/O-intensive and memory-demanding workloads, including relational databases, NoSQL datastores, Elasticsearch clusters, transactional logging, and caching platforms requiring fast local scratch storage.
